verdict.rationale: Brex's own Team API exposes a `legal_entity_id` filter, which implies the account models multiple legal entities. Its marketing mentions global spend and payments in more currencies, so multi-entity and multi-currency support is only glancingly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented consolidated reporting across entities, per-entity books/ledgers, explicit multi-currency account and reporting handling, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
